hold_reason: C1-WORLD-MODEL remains the next pending criterion, but autonomous generation is blocked until canonical identity, confidence semantics, and durable Supabase graph persistence are specified and reviewed.

missions.title: Bridge intelligence observations into the World Model
missions.objective: Project normalized IntelligenceObservation records into stable graph nodes, preserving source, provenance, observed time, confidence, and scope.
missions.expected_result: Repeated observations are idempotent; cross-source identity is merged only through an explicit canonical key; uncertain identities remain separate; current state is queryable by scope and reconstructible from append-only evidence.
